rigveda.name: Rigveda with Meters
rigveda.description: Complete Rigveda verses with identified chandas, seers, and deities

chandovallari.name: Chandovallari Collection
chandovallari.description: Classical Sanskrit poetry examples with chandas identification

chandas_vedanga.name: Chandas as Vedanga
chandas_vedanga.description: Vedic chandas classification (Daivi, Asuri, Prajapatya) with examples

iitk_meters.name: IITK Meter Definitions
iitk_meters.description: Comprehensive collection of Sama, Vishama, and Ardhasama meter definitions with L-G patterns

matra_iitk.name: Matra Meters (IITK)

jaati_iitk.name: Jaati Classification (IITK)

atharvaveda.name: Atharvaveda
atharvaveda.description: Comprehensive collection of Atharvaveda verses with identified chandas, merged from multiple validated sources
atharvaveda.sourceReference: Atharvaveda Samhita - validated Vedic verses with meter identifications

sourceDescriptions.GRETIL / Vedaweb: Göttingen Register of Electronic Texts in Indian Languages (GRETIL) and VedaWeb project digital corpus
sourceDescriptions.Chandovallari (Classical Treatise): A classical Sanskrit treatise on prosody containing examples of various meters
